COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
C 482 No. 2125 of 2023
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. M. K. Kapurwan, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mr. Saurabh Pandey, learned Brief Holder for the 
State.
3. Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for the CBI. 
4. Defect, as pointed out by the Registry is ignored.
5. List on 29.02.2024.
6. In the meantime, learned counsel for the State 
and the CBI get instructions in the matter and apprise 
this Court whether trial is still going on, since earlier 
investigation was carried out by the police wherein 
charge-sheet has been filed and cognizance was taken 
on 11.02.2011 and thereafter, this Court by the 
judgment dated 23.01.2015 transferred the investigation 
to CBI and the CBI after investigation filed a closure 
report. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)

COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
C 482 No. 2125 of 2023
Hon’ble Rakesh Thapliyal, J.
1. Mr. M.K. Kaparwan, learned counsel for the 
applicant.
2. Mr. Saurabh Pandey, learned Brief Holder for the 
State.
3. Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned counsel for the CBI.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that 
investigation was transferred to CBI by this High Court 
and the CBI after investigation submitted its closure 
report, but trial is still going on, on the basis of charge￾sheet filed by the state investigating agency. 
5. On the previous occasion, this Court directed the 
State Counsel and counsel for the CBI to get the 
complete instructions in the matter but their 
instructions are yet not complete. 
6. List this case on 20.03.2024. 
7. In the meantime, both the counsel may file their 
counter affidavit.
8. In the meantime, further proceedings of Sessions 
Trial No. 18 of 2011 (State Vs. Pawan Raj) pending in 
the court of 1st Addl. Sessions Judge, Rishikesh, 
Dehradun shall remain stayed. 
 (Rakesh Thapliyal, J.)
 29.02.2024
SKS

 COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
C482 No.2125 of 2023
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. M.K. Kapruwan, learned counsel for the 
Applicant. 
2. Mr. Bhaskar Chandra Joshi, learned AGA for 
the State.
3. None appeared for C.B.I. 
4. As per order sheet dated 29.02.2024 the 
Coordinate Bench of this Court had recorded a very 
contradictory procedure being adopted by two 
separate agencies; on by the CBI and another by the 
regular police. 
5. It is noted that CBI had filed a closure report 
whereas the charge sheet had been filed by the other 
agency.
6. As per instruction of the Coordinate Bench, 
the learned counsel for the CBI had to apprise this 
Court regarding the same averment as mentioned 
above but it seems there is no update on behalf of 
the CBI.
7. A notice in this regard be issued to the 
learned counsel for CBI, who is looking after the 
matter of CBI in the High Court as well as the State 
counsel representing the present matter. 
8. Let an update be furnished by the next date 
fixed.
9. List on 06.11.2025. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 08.10.2025

COURT’S OR JUDGE’S ORDERS
C482 No.2125 of 2023
Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. M.K. Kapruwan, learned counsel for the 
Applicant.
2. Mr. Bhaskar Chandra Joshi, learned AGA for 
the State.
3. Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned Deputy Solicitor 
General and Mr. Piyush Garg, learned counsel for 
the C.B.I.
4. As per orders passed by this Court vide order 
dated 08.10.2025 whereby on the directions of this 
Court a report had been submitted by Police Station 
Rishikesh, Dehradun.
5. The report is very ambiguous and is not clear; 
accordingly directions were sought from the learned 
counsel representing CBI and learned State counsel.
6. As it surfaces from the said submission that 
the matter is pending before 1st Additional District 
Judge, Rishikesh, District Dehradun. 
7. A closure report had been filed by the CBI 
whereby no protest application was invited and 
instead the matter was returned to the CBI for 
placing it before learned Sessions Court (ADJ, 
Rishikesh) with Sessions Trial No.18 of 2011 State 
vs. Pawan Raj under Section 365 and 366 of IPC.
8. The proceedings of the said case had been 
stayed by this Court vide order dated 29.02.2024.
9. As per the segmentation regarding the 
allotment of present matter, the matter has been 
assigned to learned counsel Mr. Lalit Sharma, 
learned Deputy Solicitor General for CBI.
10. Mr. Lalit Sharma, learned Deputy Solicitor 
General for CBI is requested to update this Court as 
exactly what preceded in the said case after the 
closure report had been filed before the learned CBI 
Court and as per the Court’s order dated 10.08.2023
wherein the learned CBI Court had returned the  matter to the CBI to be placed before the Sessions 
Court.
11. Learned counsel for CBI is requested to place 
a detailed report as exactly what proceeding before 
the matter was returned back on the following:-
i. Was there any hearing regarding the 
closure report by learned CBI court ?
ii. Whether any protest application had 
been entertained?
iii. After the matter was returned back to 
the CBI what did CBI do to the said matter?
12. Learned State counsel is also requested to 
update the matter pending before learned Additional 
District Judge, Rishikesh, District Dehradun in 
Sessions Trial No.18 of 2011 State vs. Pawan Raj.
13. List on 09.01.2026. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 17.12.2025
